case_title: XIE, PENG FEI VS SALGUT, VEHBI

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,700.00 FILED BY XIE, PENG FEI AS TO DEFENDANT SALGUT, VEHBI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-10-2007 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
